meta.grade_key: Grade = how often this rung hits (60% last-10 + 40% last-15 clear rate, with form/price/matchup modifiers). It says nothing about whether the price is good. A+>=90 A>=85 A->=80 B 70-79 C 60-69 D<60 F=hard hold.
rules: 3-4 legs per ticket (2 on TNF/MNF, reduced payout)
no shared legs across tickets (A+ may anchor two)
floor rung is the floor rung
never a leg we know is overpriced
no attempt props when favored by 7+
